question: Does the existing native W interaction provide a source-derived current kernel and the nondegenerate family time response required by the existing Yukawa target?
summary_de: Der bestehende native W-Hamiltonoperator liefert ohne neuen GN-Skalar eine exakte zeitnichtlokale Paar-/Stromwirkung mit Matsubara-Kern 1/(Delta-i omega). Im invarianten Zustand bleibt die Gram-normalisierte Familienzeitantwort fuer jeden konstanten linearen Filter skalar. Die vorhandene Lepton-Hierarchie verlangt nichtgleiche Singularwerte; ein paralleler Yukawa-Homomorphismus auf dem irreduziblen A4-Familienlokalsystem kann sie nicht erzeugen. Die notwendige nichtparallele dynamische Familienquelle muss aus P1/P2 hergeleitet werden. Archivierte modulare Variation setzt die minimale Operatorfaser voraus.
resolved: Existing finite native bosons integrate out exactly to a Euclidean quartic pair action, retaining the full oriented frequency kernel.
The already known native Casimir identity supplies the bilocal spinor-current Fierz form without identifying it with a vector-Majorana GN channel.
Exact full-kernel relative band error is abs(omega)/sqrt(Delta^2+omega^2), not generically quadratic.
For a scalar native correlator and constant full-rank linear embedding, Gram-normalized time response remains scalar for all times.
The existing unequal charged-lepton Yukawa target cannot be a parallel Hom map between unitary local systems with irreducible rank-three input holonomy.
A4 twirl provides an exact positive holonomy-commutator test for unequal target squared singular values.
Archived master-functional variation is on a previously fixed branch; minimal-defect existence, fibre uniqueness and physical selection are distinct obligations.
kills: Constant linear field filters or Clock basis rotations alone split the normalized family energies of the invariant native W source.
A parallel 3+1 determinant direction splits the three irreducible families.
A parallel Yukawa map between the declared unitary irreducible family local systems has unequal nonzero singular values.
The local Casimir Hamiltonian equals the full native eliminated dynamics at arbitrary frequencies.
The Euclidean oriented pair kernel can be replaced by its real part with only quadratic error without an additional justification.
The archived zero/infinity barrier independently derives the complete minimal source orbit that it already names.
assumptions: Existing finite native H with Delta positive, the pinned W tensor and coherent-state regulator inherited from H.
Invariant Gibbs state or the previously proved unique invariant ground state for 0<abs(g)/Delta<=1/20.
Constant full-rank linear fields from one irreducible source multiplet for the normalized-time exclusion.
Unitary connections, parallelity of Y and irreducible rank-three source holonomy for the parallel-Hom exclusion.
Existing TFPT charged-lepton formula is a comparison target, not a native pole measurement.
not_claimed: Selection of H, g, Delta or the full charged field state from the original P1/P2 source.
Complete evaluation of all interacting native correlators.
A native physical retarded real-time C_RL kernel or a 16-vector-Majorana GN embedding.
Derivation of the required nonparallel Yukawa source or distinct physical pole masses.
Necessity of nonzero curvature of the flat family connection.
A complete physically admissible counterfamily of original seeds or T1-T8 closure.
leaves_open: Original source selection and full charged operator jet.
Source-derived nonparallel Yukawa map or a justified different operator-multiplicity/state assignment.
Joint charge, product, Gram, holonomy and physical time matching on that same source.
